text:
Maya Cheng: Heads up — this morning we saw a cascade of spot interruptions in us-west-2 that pushed a bunch of inference pods into recovery and spiked p95 latency to 950ms for a 10m window.
Alex Rivera: ugh. any single point of failure?
Maya Cheng: Not single point, but our current autoscaler aggressively scales down spot-backed pools after idle 120s, which freed capacity we then lost to preemption.
Jin Park: Can you paste the autoscale config? I want to see cooldowns + surge settings.
Maya Cheng: Sure — current relevant bits:
```
autoscaler:
  min_replicas: 4
  max_replicas: 200
  scale_out_threshold: 0.75
  scale_in_threshold: 0.25
  scale_down_cooldown_s: 120
  scale_up_cooldown_s: 30
  surge_capacity_pct: 0
  prefer_spot: true
```
Samir Patel: prefer_spot:true + zero surge_capacity is bad for inference. If a bunch of spots go away you have no buffer to keep latency SLOs.
Alex Rivera: Suggestion: add mixed pools + conservative scale-down cooldown and positive surge. e.g., keep a small on-demand pool (dedicated) as hot standbys.
Jin Park: Agreed. Proposal:
- make base_on_demand: 10% of fleet (or min 8 GPUs)
- increase scale_down_cooldown_s to 300s
- surge_capacity_pct: 12
- enable graceful_drain_timeout_s: 60
- interruption_hook: drain-to-dedicated-route

Maya Cheng: That seems reasonable. Also add backoff on scale-outs to avoid stampeding new spot requests when we get short-lived bursts.
Samir Patel: +1. Add exponential scale_up backoff and cap concurrent scale_up ops to 2.
Alex Rivera: We should also surface the interruption rate to Console / alerts. Something like alert when spot_retries_per_min > 5 and spot_interruption_rate > 0.02.
infra-oncall: Incident noted: created ticket INF-4217 to implement autoscaler changes and alerting.
ops-bot: deploy plan draft pushed to repo: gitlab.com/redwood-infra/spot-autoscale/-/merge_requests/87
Maya Cheng: For rollout, propose canary: apply to 2 AZs in us-west-2 with 15% traffic, run for 2 hours, check p95 and error rate. If good, gradual to 100% over 3 hours.
Jin Park: One more callout — make sure cache behavior for prefix KV is pinned to dedicated capacity for hot shards, avoids cold starts on spot nodes.
Samir Patel: I'll update the k8s HorizontalPodAutoscaler CRD with new fields and add unit tests.
Alex Rivera: Also run a small chaos test: kill 20% of spots in us-west-2 staging and verify automatic reroute and no SLO violations.
Maya Cheng: Perfect. I'll own rollout + canary monitoring dashboard (token-level latency + tail + request failures).
Jin Park: TL;DR action items:
- Samir: change autoscaler defaults (300s cooldown, surge 12%, cap concurrent scale_up=2, exponential backoff)
- Samir: add interruption_hook to drain to dedicated route + drain timeout 60s
- Samir: ensure min_on_demand = max(8, 10% fleet)
- Maya: canary rollout + dashboard
- Alex: chaos test scenario + runbook
- infra-oncall: alert rule for spot_interruption_rate

Maya Cheng: Ping me if you need logs. I clipped a snippet of the spike:
```
[2025-11-29T08:12:04Z] node/spot-72b9 terminated by provider (preempted)
[2025-11-29T08:12:05Z] pod/inference-abc restarted on spot-9f3a
[2025-11-29T08:12:18Z] request_latency p95=950ms p50=120ms fill_rate=0.85
```
Alex Rivera: Great, let's try to ship this today if possible. :thumbsup:
